focal_point: A giant per-opening savings figure on the front, over a full-bleed photo of the finished windows in a real house. The figure is the only type event.
eye_path: Diagonal from the house to the figure to one phone. The back switches to proof and the same phone.
grid: Full-bleed photo plus one offer band. Back is a simpler proof stack in the same palette.
scale_ratios: The offer numerals are far larger than the short headline. This is the hero-numeral rule, at or above 1.6×. Front uses about three sizes.
type_choices: One heavy grotesque. Numeral, short headline, phone. No script.
photo_art_direction: Finished exterior, natural light, the product in use on a local house. No stock family. Back continues the same material story.
offer_placement: One offer architecture: amount off each window, a related amount off each door, and a small whole-job qualifier. It is still one offer, stated as a pair of figures in one lockup, not two campaigns.
trust_and_cta: One phone on the front. Back repeats the phone, a license, and an end date that is printed as a real date rather than a fake official fuse.

hierarchy.reason: Numeral, then a short line, then the phone.

eye_path.reason: Three stops, then the back is proof.

gestalt.reason: The figures and the phone are one group.

contrast.reason: Dark type on a light band.

whitespace.reason: The sky in the photo is the calm field.

color.reason: Colors come from the house plus one dark band.

trust.reason: License on the back, photo on the front.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets the number and the house.

emulate: Result photo full-bleed. One numeral lockup at least 1.6× the headline. One phone. Proof and license on the back.
do_not_copy: The mark, the amounts, the phone, the photos, the end date.
anti_patterns: Do not split the window figure and the door figure into two equal columns.
summary: Best-designed piece in the mailbox, and the top of the whole corpus. A finished house, one savings lockup, one phone. Style reference only: copy the structure, not the brand.
